tasks.prompt: Review the changes on this branch against main before I merge them. Tell me what must be fixed first.

assertions.text: Identifies that find_by_email builds its SQL query by string interpolation and is open to SQL injection.
Identifies that page() skips the first page of results because page_number starts at 1 but is used as a zero-based index.
Identifies that display_name fails when a user's name is missing or None.
Makes clear which problems block the merge, rather than listing every issue at equal weight.
Does not report defects that are not present in the diff.

tasks.prompt: Can you review this branch before it goes in? It adds retries for failed requests.

assertions.text: Points out that retrying every method, including POST, can repeat non-idempotent requests.
Points out that after the last attempt the function returns None instead of raising, hiding the failure from callers.
Points out that the fixed one-second sleep has no backoff.
Points out that catching every Exception also retries errors that will never succeed, such as client errors or programming bugs.
Notes that the tests cover only the success path and not retries or the final failure.
